comments.author: @evp3891
comments.text: I just returned from a two week holiday in Japan. It was my first time. Travelling by train from Osaka to Kobe and seeing all the houses built so closely to the train line and each other, I will never look at my house in Sydney the same again, and i will never ever take my large backyard with pool for granted, ever again.

comments.author: @EarthsLastPlaces
comments.text: The image of two buildings so close that the sky shrinks to a thin strip really sets up the tiny-homes idea. I'm curious how a restaurant with room for only a handful of customers keeps going.

comments.author: @PrimeTravel2
comments.text: Japan never stops surprising me. The contrast between modern city life, tiny homes, and the hidden world beneath the streets is fascinating. There is always another side of Japan waiting to be discovered!
